maddeler.e:
تبتدهوا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِهُوا (tabtadihū) /tab.ta.di.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# تُبْتَدَهُوا (tubtadahū) /tub.ta.da.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
